CANDLESTICK REVERSAL SIGNALS 

🔍 Inverted Hammer An Inverted Hammer usually appears after a downtrend and shows that buyers are starting to step in.
Example: Downtrend → Inverted Hammer → buyers push price higher → potential BUY signal.
👉 Don’t buy just because you see an Inverted Hammer. Wait for confirmation from the next candle or market structure

🔍 Shooting Star A Shooting Star usually appears after an uptrend and shows strong rejection from higher prices
Example: Uptrend → Shooting Star → price gets rejected from the highs → potential SELL signal
👉 A Shooting Star becomes more meaningful when it forms around a Supply Zone or Resistance

🔍 Doji A Doji represents indecision between buyers and sellers. The opening and closing prices are very close
Example: Uptrend → Doji → momentum starts slowing → WAIT for confirmation.
👉 A Doji does not automatically mean reversal. Always look at the next candle and the overall market structure

🔍 Bearish Engulfing A Bearish Engulfing forms when a strong bearish candle completely engulfs the previous bullish candle
Example: Uptrend → small bullish candle → large bearish candle engulfs it → sellers take control → potential SELL

🔍 Bullish Engulfing A Bullish Engulfing is the opposite. A strong bullish candle completely engulfs the previous bearish candle
Example: Downtrend → small bearish candle → large bullish candle engulfs it → buyers take control → potential BUY

🔍 Marubozu A Marubozu is a strong candle with a large body and little to no wick.
 Bullish Marubozu: Buyers are in strong control. 🔴 Bearish Marubozu: Sellers are in strong control
👉 Marubozu shows strong momentum, but always read it within the market structure

🔍 Morning Star The Morning Star usually appears after a downtrend and can signal a shift from sellers to buyers
Example: Strong drop → small indecision candle → strong bullish candle → buyers regain control → potential BUY

🔍 Evening Star The Evening Star is the opposite of the Morning Star.
Example: Strong rally → small indecision candle → strong bearish candle → sellers regain control → potential SELL

🔍 Three Black Crows Three consecutive bearish candles usually show strong selling pressure, especially after an uptrend
Example: Uptrend → 3 strong bearish candles → bearish momentum increases → possible reversal to the downside
